## Headroom Learned Patterns
*Auto-generated by `headroom learn` on 2026-11-07 — do not edit manually*

### Tool usage
*~5,000 tokens/session saved*
- `mcp__headroom__headroom_retrieve` requires a `hash` arg; never call it empty. Take the hash from the line preceding compressed output (`[N items compressed ... Retrieve more: hash=...]`) and copy it verbatim before calling. (Failed again in /pipeline iterate with `{}`.)
- Pipeline review-finish: read `review.json`, `result.json`, `transcript.md`, `rv.err` in one parallel Read batch, then write `.review/review-<n>-tasks.md` and file it via `bk.ps1`. Check `.review` ignore status in the same call as `Test-Path`.
- Pipeline iterate: run git/bk probes (`git fetch`, `git log origin/main..`, `git diff --shortstat origin/main...HEAD`, `bk.ps1 peek`) in one batched PowerShell call instead of many sequential ones. Compressed diff output is retrievable by hash, so avoid re-running `git show`/`git diff` variants to see the rest. Use one `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- <paths>` with no `Select-Object` truncation when the full diff is needed.
- Before running `integrate.ps1`, confirm the working tree is clean (`git status --short`); untracked build dirs (`build-msvc-*`, `out-*`) block it, so make sure they are in `.git/info/exclude` first.
